Webhook is event notification from one service to another HTTP endpoint. Verify signature, handle retries,
deduplicate and acknowledge quickly.
Webhook එJකන් provider එක event එකක් සිදුවුණු JවලොJවේ server endpoint එකට notify කරනවා.
Signature verify කරලො duplicate events handle කරන්න.
Provider event Signed webhook Verify + deduplicate Update order
Read the diagram: Do not trust a browser redirect as proof of payment; verify authoritative event and transaction.
Expected result: Valid unique event updates the order once; duplicate delivery is acknowledged safely.

Interview question: Why are webhooks retried?
Answer: Delivery can fail, so providers often retry until acknowledged according to their policy.
Practice: Design webhook handling for duplicates and out-of-order events.
